newsitem.title: UK: Hambro Countrywide, RPT agree offer terms.
newsitem.headline: Hambro Countrywide, RPT agree offer terms.

text.p: UK estate agency Hambro Countrywide Plc and RPT Management Services have agreed terms for a recommended cash offer for RPT, valuing its share capital at about 8.4 billion sterling, Hambros Bank Ltd said on Sunday.

"The offer is 114 pence in cash for each RPT ordinary share, with a loan note alternative and with shareholders being entitled to retail RPT's interim dividend payment of 1.5 pence (net)," the bank said in a statement released in London.
"The offer values RPT's existing issued share capital at approximately 8.4 billion pounds."

The bank said Hambro Countrywide had received irrevokable undertakings to accept the offer from some of RPT's directors and shareholders in respect of 51.9 percent of the company's existing issued shared capital.
The undertakings would remain binding even if a competing offer for the London-based residential property investment and management company were made, it added.
